qa_pairs.question: What symptom indicates a fuel pump control relay issue?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuel pump running only during starting procedures.

qa_pairs.question: How do you check the power supply of the control relay?
qa_pairs.answer: Pull off plug on control relay and connect voltmeter (M 01) between conn. 30 on disconnected control relay plug and ground. Voltmeter must display battery voltage.

qa_pairs.question: What should you do if the voltage value is not okay when checking connection 30?
Which connection should you test after conn. 30 when checking the control relay?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect voltmeter (M 01) between conn. 15 on disconnected control relay socket and ground, then turn on ignition.

qa_pairs.question: What voltage reading should you get when testing conn. 50 with the engine started?
qa_pairs.answer: Voltmeter should display battery voltage when the engine is started.

qa_pairs.question: How do you check the ground connection of the control relay?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect ohmmeter (M 06) between conn. 31 on disconnected control relay plug and ground. Ohmmeter should display approx. 0 ohm.

qa_pairs.question: What should you do if the resistance value is not okay when checking the ground connection?
qa_pairs.answer: Repair wire. Electric ground (see wiring diagram).

qa_pairs.question: How do you check the speed signal for the control relay?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect voltmeter (M 02) between conn. 1 on disconnected control relay plug and ground. Voltmeter should display voltage.

qa_pairs.question: What should you check if no voltage is displayed during the speed signal test?
qa_pairs.answer: Check ignition system. Ignition system okay?
